entries.text: The first creatures, 185 Lameza, landed on the empty shore.
Strangers landed: 15 Nemafa came ashore from elsewhere.
Among the Lameza was born the island's first giant.
The first amphibious creature appeared among the Lameza.
Among the Lameza was born the island's first creature that sleeps through the cold.
Among the Nemafa was born the island's first creature that glows in the dark.
Among the Lameza was born the island's first long-lived creature.
The Nemafa took to the water: the island's first swimmers.
The first giant trees above the canopy took root on the island.
The first fruit trees took root on the island.
The Nemafa multiply: 41 now, 15 a month ago.
Among the Lameza was born the island's first poisonous creature with warning colours.
The Lameno split from the Lameza.
Autumn came. 200 creatures of 3 species live on the island.
